arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Data from treasury bulletins (in thousands of dollars)
fy_2010_ny = 200209720  # FY 2010 New York
fy_2015_ny = 269716999  # FY 2015 New York
fy_2024_ny = 384447300  # FY 2024 New York (actual)

# Step 1: Calculate CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015
years_1 = 2015 - 2010  # 5 years
cagr_2010_2015 = (fy_2015_ny / fy_2010_ny) ** (1 / years_1) - 1
print(f"CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015: {cagr_2010_2015:.6f} ({cagr_2010_2015*100:.4f}%)")

# Step 2: Calculate projected FY 2024 value using CAGR with FY 2015 as base
years_2 = 2024 - 2015  # 9 years
projected_fy_2024 = fy_2015_ny * ((1 + cagr_2010_2015) ** years_2)
print(f"Projected FY 2024 value: {projected_fy_2024:,.2f} thousand dollars")
print(f"Actual FY 2024 value: {fy_2024_ny:,.2f} thousand dollars")

# Step 3: Calculate percentage difference relative to actual FY 2024
# Formula: ((Projected - Actual) / Actual) * 100
percentage_diff = ((projected_fy_2024 - fy_2024_ny) / fy_2024_ny) * 100
print(f"Percentage difference: {percentage_diff:.4f}%")

# Round to nearest hundredths
print(f"Rounded percentage difference: {round(percentage_diff, 2)}%")
EOF
